title: YAPS AntiCheat
description: Yet Another Powerful Shield — an all-in-one anti-cheat for modern Paper 1.21.x servers, featuring 18 detection modules, an advanced ban punishment system, and a admin GUI.
body:
🎯 18 Detection Modules
Combat

KillAura & MultiAura — impossible-angle hits + multi-target detection
Reach — extended reach detection with Mace fall-attack buffer (1.21.11)
SilentAim / TriggerBot — facing-angle and instant-hit detection
AutoClicker — CPS cap + click-jitter analysis (perfect rhythm = flag)
Movement

Fly, Speed, Jesus (water-walk)
NoSlowdown, Spider (with sustained-climb logic — no false positives on jumps)
Step, NoWeb
1.21.11 Wind Charge immunity — 3s pause on movement checks after Wind Charge use
Player & World

NoFall — packet-spoof detection + auto damage restore
FastPlace & Scaffolding (auto-bridge detection)
FastBreak, AutoEat, AutoArmor
Exploits & Packets

Timer — move-packet-per-second cap
InvalidPackets — packet flood protection with auto-kick on DDoS attempts
⚖️ Advanced Ban Punishment System
A complete rebuild of the Ban punishment model:


📜 Custom Layouts system (Messages.yml + Layouts.yml) — fully customizable messages with @CustomLayout and #TimeLayout references

🔇 Silent flag -s on all punish commands (only ab.notify.silent receivers see it)

🛡️ Exempt players list — unbannable players (console override)

⏱️ Duration caps via ab.tempban.dur.1/2/3/.../max permission tiers

📊 WarnActions — auto-execute commands on warn-count milestones

💾 Persistent storage in data.yml — all punishments survive restarts

🚫 Mute bypass protection — blocks /minecraft:me and 10+ chat commands

🎨 Admin GUI Open with /yaps
